findings.cause: The last daily signal is recipe second86400; the SHORT second parent is admitted after the H4 input at100800. Final129600/129601 inputs contain only VenueMark/QuoteTick objects. Normal TP fill terminal calls domain.on_parent_terminal→on_parent_cancelled, which retains an episode with historical BTC entry quantity. Plain VenueMark/QuoteTick callbacks do not invoke _submit_terminal_closes; terminal_close_at_ns is checked for dispatch only in _try_advance_session at a paired DAILY signal (wave_overlay.py:1190). Consequently all real second TP fills and fully flat native Cache do not imply domain.episode=None, yet run_case asserts exactly that.
